Indian Navy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry Scheme 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the date of application. Only unmarried men and women fulfilling the conditions of nationality as laid down by the Government of India are eligible. Any candidate found to be married or who marries while under training will be discharged from service and shall be liable to refund full training cost including pay, allowances and any other expenditure incurred by the Government.

Criteria Details
Nationality As per conditions of nationality laid down by the Government of India.
Marital Status Unmarried men and women only. Candidates who marry while under training will be discharged and must refund all training costs.
Educational Qualification Passed Senior Secondary Examination (10+2 pattern) or equivalent from any recognized Board with at least 70% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (PCM) and at least 50% marks in English (either in Class X or Class XII).
JEE (Main) 2026 Requirement Must have appeared for JEE (Main) 2026 exam (for B.E./B.Tech). Call up for SSB will be issued on the basis of JEE (Main) All India Common Rank List (CRL) 2026 published by NTA. Candidates must fill their CRL Rank in the application.
Medical Standards All candidates recommended by SSB must undergo medical examination applicable to 10+2 (B.Tech) entry. Candidates already declared medically fit for NDA/INA Jan 27 need not repeat medical examination. No relaxation in medical standards on any grounds. Change of medical hospital/centre is not permissible under any circumstances.
Narcotics Use/possession of narcotics is banned. Candidates may be tested during SSB/medicals/training/service. If found using/possessing narcotics at any stage, candidate will be debarred from joining or removed from service.

Indian Navy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry Scheme 2026 - Age Limit

Candidates must have been born between 02 July 2007 and 01 January 2010 (both dates inclusive) to be eligible for the January 2027 course. There is no separate age relaxation mentioned — the age band is fixed for all candidates.

All candidates (Men and Women) Born between 02-07-2007 and 01-01-2010 (both dates inclusive)

The notification does not mention any application fee. Candidates are advised to check the official Indian Navy recruitment website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in for any fee-related information before submitting the online application.

Indian Navy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry Scheme 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be based on JEE (Main) 2026 CRL-based shortlisting, followed by SSB Interview, Medical Examination, and Police & Character Verification. Merit list will be prepared based on SSB marks and medical fitness. Candidates will be appointed subject to Police Verification, Character Verification, and availability of vacancies in the entry. Mere inclusion in the common merit list does not confer a vested right to appointment. Mere empanelment under no circumstances can be treated as final selection.

Stage 1 - Shortlisting Based on JEE (Main) 2026 CRL

Naval Headquarters reserves the right to fix the cut-off for shortlisting of applications for SSB based on JEE (Main) All India Common Rank List (CRL) 2026. All candidates must fill their CRL Rank in the application. Shortlisted candidates will be informed about their SSB interview schedule through email and SMS. Candidates must not change their email/mobile number until the selection process is over.

Stage 2 - Service Selection Board (SSB) Interview

SSB interviews for shortlisted candidates will be scheduled at Bengaluru / Bhopal / Kolkata / Visakhapatnam from September 2026 onwards. Change of SSB Centre is not permissible under any circumstances. Candidates must download the call-up letter on receiving intimation from Naval Headquarters via SMS/email. AC 3-tier rail fare is admissible for SSB interview if appearing for the first time for this particular type of commission — candidates must bring a photocopy of the first page of passbook or cheque leaf with Name, A/C No., and IFSC details. No compensation is admissible in case of any injury sustained during SSB tests.

Stage 3 - Medical Examination

All candidates recommended by SSB must undergo medical examination as per standards applicable to 10+2 (B.Tech) entry. No relaxation in medical standards on any grounds. Candidates already declared medically fit for NDA/INA Jan 27 need not repeat medical examination. Change of medical hospital/centre is not permissible under any circumstances.

Stage 4 - Common Merit List & Appointment

Final merit list will be prepared based on SSB marks and medical fitness. Candidates will be appointed subject to Police Verification, Character Verification, and availability of vacancies. All vacancies are to be filled as per service requirement and statutory guidelines issued from time to time.

Indian Navy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry Scheme 2026 - Training Details

Selected candidates will be inducted as Cadets for the four-year B.Tech Course at the Indian Naval Academy (INA), Ezhimala, in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Naval Architecture & Shipbuilding (only for 07 selected candidates from Mechanical Engineering at NCW, Kochi) as per Naval requirements. On completion of the course, B.Tech Degree will be awarded by Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU). The entire cost of training including books and reading material will be borne by the Indian Navy. Cadets will also be provided with entitled clothing and messing. Details of pay, allowances, group insurance, gratuity, leave entitlements, and duties of officers are available on www.joinindiannavy.gov.in.

How to Apply for Indian Navy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry Scheme January 2027

Candidates must register and submit their application online only at the official Indian Navy recruitment website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in. No other mode of application is accepted. Candidates are advised to read all instructions on the website carefully before submitting the online application. The application once submitted is final and no request for amendments or changes will be entertained.

Candidates must ensure that all details including email address and mobile number are mandatory fields and are correctly filled. Personal particulars must match exactly with Matriculation/12th Class certificates. Candidature will be cancelled if any declaration is found wrong at any stage of selection.

BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Candidates must pay the non-refundable application fee online through the SBI Collect portal only (https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm?corpID=1232156) in favour of Commandant, GREF Centre, Pune-411 015. No other mode of payment will be accepted. A copy of the e-receipt must be attached with the application form.

Category Application Fee
General (UR) / EWS / Ex-Servicemen / Ex-Agniveers / OBC Rs 50/- (Non-Refundable)
SC / ST NIL
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) NIL

BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

All candidates will undergo the recruitment process in the following sequence: (i) Written Examination, (ii) Physical Efficiency Test (PET) including physical measurements and Trade Test (TT) where applicable, (iii) Primary Medical Examination (PME) and Document Verification (DV), and (iv) Induction/Joining. The PET and TT are qualifying in nature - final merit is based solely on written exam marks, subject to qualifying PET, TT, and clearing PME. Minimum passing marks in written exam: 50% for UR/EWS/OBC; 40% for SC/ST. Trade test requires minimum 40% marks to qualify.

Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Candidate must complete 1.6 km (1 mile) run in 10 minutes. PwBD, ESM, Ex-Agniveers, and departmental re-appointment candidates are exempt from PET.

Competition Level Analysis for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026

The competition level for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 is expected to be moderate to high. The recruitment is restricted to Male candidates only, which reduces the applicant pool compared to open-gender recruitments. However, 899 vacancies across technical/trade posts will attract a large number of ITI-qualified and Matriculation-level candidates, especially for high-vacancy posts like Store Keeper Technical (300) and Operator Communication (261). The written exam followed by PET and Trade Test provides multiple elimination stages, but candidates with relevant ITI trade certificates and physical fitness will have a clear advantage. Ex-Servicemen and Ex-Agniveers get significant age relaxation and weightage, which makes certain trades more competitive in that segment.

The key differentiator here is the offline application process - many eligible candidates may miss out due to postal delays or incorrect application format, effectively reducing actual competition at the written exam stage. Candidates who submit complete and correct applications well before the deadline and prepare trade-specific written exam syllabi will have a significant edge.

Who should NOT apply for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026?

  • Female candidates - this recruitment is strictly for Indian National Males only.
  • Candidates who do not possess the requisite educational/technical qualification as on the closing date of application; those awaiting final exam results are not eligible.
  • Candidates outside the age band 18-27 years as on 01 Jun 2026 (except those eligible for applicable category-based relaxation).
  • OBC candidates from the Creamy Layer - they are not entitled to OBC reservation or age relaxation and must apply as UR/General category.
  • Candidates who cannot meet the region-wise physical standards (height, chest, weight) as physical fitness is mandatory for induction.
  • Candidates with permanent medical conditions listed as grounds for permanent rejection (colour blindness for Drivers/Operators, cardiac conditions, gross myopia, etc.) who cannot pass the Primary Medical Examination at GREF Centre.
  • Candidates unwilling or unable to be posted anywhere in India, especially in remote, high-altitude, or difficult terrain areas in Northern and Eastern regions.
  • Candidates who cannot arrange and send a physical application form with photograph, thumb impression, signature, fee e-receipt, and attested copies by post to Pune - there is no online application mode.
  • Candidates with tattoos on any body part other than the inner forearm (inside elbow to wrist) or reverse palm - tattoos on other parts lead to disqualification at PME.
  • Ex-servicemen who have already joined Govt civil service using ESM benefits and are claiming ESM status again - such candidates are treated as civilian employees.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying BRO GREF Recruitment 2026?

  • Not printing the application form on A4 size 75 GSM bond paper (one side only) and admit card on both sides of a single paper as mandated - non-standard paper leads to rejection.
  • Applying without attaching the e-receipt copy of the application fee paid via SBI Collect; no other payment mode is accepted and missing receipt causes rejection.
  • Sending the application from a wrong/old address instead of present postal address - applications posted from wrong address are rejected to prevent fraudulent claims of 60-day receipt benefit.
  • Not superscribing the envelope with "APPLICATION FOR (NAME OF TRADE/POST) Under Category (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/ESM/CPL)" as required - unlabelled envelopes may be misdirected.
  • Mismatch between name in application and name in Matriculation certificate - even a dropped or added part of the name requires a Gazette Notification; otherwise candidature is summarily cancelled.
  • Submitting multiple applications for the same post with different details or photographs - this results in lifetime debarment from all GREF examinations.
  • OBC/EWS certificate dated older than one year from the closing date - OBC and EWS certificates must be fresh (not older than one year as on closing date) and in the prescribed Central Govt format.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post/trade using the same envelope - each post requires a separate application with separate fee in a separate envelope.
  • Not carrying the minimum 12 passport-size photographs (same as pasted on application and admit card) to all subsequent recruitment stages - shortage of photos causes disruption at PET/TT/PME stages.
  • Ignoring the trade-specific syllabus and treating the written exam as a general knowledge test - each post has a distinct subject-wise syllabus and candidates must prepare trade-specific topics.

How to Apply for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply offline only; no online application mode is available. Application form and admit card must be downloaded from the official BRO website (www.bro.gov.in) and filled in English or Hindi only, in capital letters. The application form must be printed on A4 size 75 GSM bond paper (one side only) and admit card printed on both sides of a single paper. Candidates must first pay the application fee online via SBI Collect portal and attach the e-receipt copy. Candidates applying for more than one post must send separate applications with separate fee in separate envelopes. Candidates are strongly advised to send applications well before the closing date and not wait for the last day - GREF Centre will not be responsible for postal delays.

Candidates should read the detailed instructions and guidelines available at https://bfsissc.com before applying.

Documents Required to be Enclosed with Application Form:

  • Recent colour passport-size photograph (not older than 1 month from the date of Advertisement) pasted at the prescribed place on application form and admit card - minimum 12 copies of the same photograph to be carried throughout the recruitment process
  • Left hand thumb impression at the prescribed place on application form and admit card
  • Signature of candidate at the prescribed place
  • Copy of e-receipt of application fee paid via SBI Collect
  • Self-attested photostat copies of certificates for essential educational/technical qualifications (Matriculation onwards), date of birth, caste certificate (as per format in Appendix A/B), OBC NCL declaration (Appendix D), EWS certificate (Appendix C), Disability Certificate (Appendix E for PwBD), experience certificate (if applicable), Driving Licence copy (for OEM post)
  • NCC certificate copies (B or C grade), sports certificate, or relationship certificate for Sons of Serving/Ex-GREF personnel - for claiming weightage marks
  • Proof of residence/domicile (for correct physical standards region)
  • Any certificate in language other than Hindi or English must be enclosed with an attested Hindi/English translation by a Group A Gazetted Officer

Send Application (by Postal Service) to: Commandant, GREF Centre, Dighi Camp, Pune - 411015

Printout / physical application is NOT to be sent anywhere else. No hard copy of admit card for written exam will be sent by post - admit card will be posted to the communication address given by the candidate in the admit card.

Application form available at: https://www.bro.gov.in

For queries: Visit https://www.bro.gov.in - all recruitment updates, results, and call letters will be displayed on the BRO website only.

Important Instructions for BRO GREF Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • Only Male Indian Nationals can apply; Female candidates are not eligible.
  • Application form and/or admit card without signature, without photograph, or without thumb impression will be summarily rejected - no communication will be done for rejected applications.
  • Candidates must ensure their Aadhaar Card photo is current (not older than 2-3 years from written exam date) and address/phone is updated; outdated Aadhaar may prevent entry to the exam.
  • Son of Serving / Ex-GREF staff should write father's GS No., Rank, and Name on top of the application in red ink with a photocopy of relationship certificate, to claim the 15% weightage benefit.
  • Casual Paid Labours (CPL) of GREF who have worked for 179 days in the last one year and are on the Muster Roll on the date of advertisement publication get 10% additional weightage - attach experience certificate signed by OC unit, countersigned by Commander BRTF and verified by Accounts Officer.
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates who qualify on their own merit (without relaxed standards) will be accommodated against UR vacancies - they must NOT apply separately against UR vacancies.
  • OBC candidates belonging to Creamy Layer are not entitled to reservation; they should apply under UR category.
  • Candidates serving in other Government Departments must apply through proper channel sufficiently in advance; applications not received by due date through proper channel will be rejected.
  • Mobile phones, smartwatches, and all electronic/communication devices are strictly NOT ALLOWED inside GREF Centre, Pune campus during any recruitment process.
  • A candidate who absents himself during any recruitment activity for which he has been called will have his candidature cancelled automatically - he will not be allowed to appear for further stages.
  • There shall be no provision for re-evaluation/re-checking of scores in examination; no correspondence in this regard shall be entertained.
  • Legal jurisdiction for any dispute arising out of this Advertisement shall fall within the jurisdiction of the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi.
  • Impersonation or submission of forged documents leads to debarment from all GREF examinations for life/2 years and legal action. GREF has not appointed any agent or coaching centre for action on its behalf - SELECTION WILL BE DONE PURELY ON MERIT IN A TRANSPARENT MANNER.
  • Vacancies are liable to increase/decrease/cancel at any stage without notice due to unforeseen situations.
  • All revisions/corrigendum will be hosted on the BRO website only - candidates should visit www.bro.gov.in regularly.

BOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the cut-off date (01-05-2026). Candidates must be registered on Government Apprenticeship Portals (NATS and/or NAPS) before applying. Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply.

Educational Qualification Graduation Degree in any Discipline from a recognized University or any equivalent qualifications recognized by the Central Government. For NATS candidates: date of passing Graduation should not be more than 4 years preceding 01-05-2026.
Prior Apprenticeship Candidate should NOT have undergone Apprenticeship with Bank of Baroda or any other Establishment in the past, and should not currently be pursuing Apprenticeship Training with any Establishment.
Training / Job Experience Candidates who had training or job experience for a period of 1 year or more after completing educational qualification shall NOT be eligible.

Selection for engagement of apprentices will be based on three stages - Online Examination, Document Verification, and Test of local language of the State. Candidates must qualify all three stages. Final selection is subject to medical fitness as per the Bank's requirements. A State-wise and Category-wise Wait List will be published for vacancies arising from non-acceptance or non-reporting by selected candidates; this wait list remains valid for 1 year from result declaration or until the next engagement exercise, whichever is earlier.

How to Apply for Bank of Baroda Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only. No other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates must first mandatorily register themselves on the Government Apprenticeship portals - NATS (https://nats.education.gov.in) and/or NAPS (https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in).

After completing registration on NAPS/NATS, eligible candidates will receive an email from [email protected] inviting them to fill the final "Application cum Examination Form" and make payment of the applicable fee/charges.

The application registration is considered complete only when fee/charges are deposited with BFSI SSC. Candidates must note down their Enrolment Id (NATS portal) and Apprentice Registration Code (NAPS portal) for all future correspondence.

Apply Online at: https://bankofbaroda.bank.in/ and https://bfsissc.com

Important Instructions for Bank of Baroda Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • This is NOT regular employment or contract employment in the Bank. Apprentices will be TRAINEES only and not employees of Bank of Baroda.
  • The apprentice shall have no right to claim employment in the Bank after completion of training. Bank of Baroda has no obligation to offer regular employment to apprentices during or after the apprenticeship period.
  • Candidates can apply for engagement as apprentice in one State/UT only. Allotment to a different State/UT will not be considered under any circumstances.
  • Candidates must first register on NATS and/or NAPS portals before applying; application without portal registration is not valid.
  • The process of registration is complete only when applicable fee/charges are deposited with BFSI SSC.
  • No Ex-servicemen / Disabled Ex-Servicemen shall be engaged as an apprentice; there is no reservation for Ex-servicemen in this engagement.
  • OBC candidates belonging to the 'Creamy Layer' are not entitled to OBC reservation and age relaxation; they should apply as General / General (OC/HI/VI/ID) as applicable.
  • Change of category once submitted in the online application will not be permitted at any stage.
  • Candidates should submit only one application; in case of multiple submissions, only the last valid completed application will be considered and fee paid for earlier registrations will be forfeited.
  • The Apprentices are prohibited from joining / forming any Union Body.
  • All correspondence will be made only on the registered email ID; candidates should keep it active throughout the recruitment process. No hard copy intimation will be sent by post for Online Examination.
  • Candidates must appear for the selection process (Document Verification, Language Test) at their own cost; Bank will not reimburse travelling expenses.
  • Apprentices will not be provided with Transport / Hostel facility or any other residential accommodation during training.
  • Stipend of Rs. 15,000/- per month will be paid on completion of each month after adjusting Loss of Pay, if any. No other allowances/benefits are payable.
  • All amendments/corrigendum (if any) will be published only on the Bank's website (https://bankofbaroda.bank.in/) and https://bfsissc.com - candidates should visit regularly.
  • Any canvassing directly or indirectly shall disqualify the candidature. Use of unfair means, impersonation, or misbehavior will lead to disqualification and/or debarment.
  • Legal jurisdiction for any dispute arising out of this recruitment shall be Mumbai only.

BPCL Experienced Professionals Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The multi-stage selection process will be adopted based on the number of applications received for each profile. Final selection is subject to document verification, performance in all selection stages, and Pre-Employment Medical Examination.

Stage 1 – Application Screening

Applications will be screened on the basis of years of relevant work experience, educational qualification, and other eligibility criteria as specified for each profile.

Stage 2 – Computer Based Test (CBT)

Part Section Details
Part I General Aptitude Verbal Ability, Quantitative Aptitude and Logical Reasoning
Part II Professional Knowledge Questions related to the area of specialization of the applied profile

Stage 3 – Case Based Discussion / Group Task / Personal Interview

Candidates shortlisted in the CBT (category-wise and discipline-wise merit list) will be called for Case Based Discussion and/or Group Task and/or Personal Interview. Document verification shall be conducted before this stage. Provisional selection will be based on relevant work experience, on-the-job achievements, and overall performance across all selection stages.

Stage 4 – Pre-Employment Medical Examination

Provisionally selected candidates must clear a Pre-Employment Medical Examination conducted by BPCL’s authorized doctor / nominated hospital as per OISD-GDN-166 guidelines. Medical fitness decision shall be final and binding. Reference for medical examination does not mean final selection.

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • All eligibility criteria - age, qualification, and experience - are reckoned as on 01-04-2026.
  • Candidates can apply for only one profile. Candidates are advised to submit only one application; in case of multiple applications, only the latest one shall be considered as final.
  • Percentage of marks is calculated on the basis of total marks obtained in all semesters/years in all subjects. Rounding off of percentage is not allowed.
  • Experience gained only after the date of declaration of result of the qualifying degree will be considered. Short-term trainee experience (summer/winter internships during degree) will not be counted.

This is not applicable for candidates already in Central / State Government Services / PSUs.
  • Corrigendum / Addendum, if any, will be published on the official BPCL website only - https://www.bharatpetroleum.in/ - candidates must check regularly.
  • BPCL reserves the right to cancel / restrict / enlarge / modify / alter the recruitment process at any stage without notice.
  • Canvassing in any form at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Court of jurisdiction for any dispute will be at Mumbai.
  • All applications are accepted through the online portal only. This activity has NOT been outsourced by BPCL to any agency/individual. Applicants are advised to beware of fraudulent agencies/individuals.

CEIL Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The notification does not mention any application fee. Applications are to be submitted online free of charge through CEIL's official recruitment portal at https://www6.eil.co.in/ceilrecruitment/.

CEIL Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Applications received will be put up to a Committee for shortlisting. Screening and selection will be based on the details provided in the application form - only accurate, full and correct information should be furnished. Furnishing of wrong/false information will result in disqualification.

For Officer Grade Posts (QA/QC, Safety, Marketing, SCM, Office Management): Shortlisting based on application details, followed by Personal Interview. Interviews will be held at CEIL office, Navi Mumbai. Online interviews (Skype, Google Meet, or similar) may also be conducted if required.

For HR Associate Category: Selection will be done through Written Test. Candidates complying with the criteria will be shortlisted for the written test.

CEIL may restrict the number of candidates called for interview / written test based on academic excellence, age, and experience. Selected candidates will be on panel and appointment letters will be issued as per requirement.

Who should NOT apply for CEIL Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not hold an Engineering Degree or Diploma in the relevant discipline with minimum 50% marks - this is a hard requirement for all technical posts.
  • Mechanical/Production QA/QC candidates who do not have ASNT Level-II certification in NDT methods (UT, RT, MPT, PT) - this is mandatory and non-negotiable.
  • Candidates who do not have the prescribed minimum post-qualification experience as on 30.04.2026 - experience counted is post-PQ only.
  • Candidates exceeding the maximum age limit for their respective grade and discipline (Degree or Diploma holder category) as on 30.04.2026.
  • Candidates looking for a permanent government job - this is a Fixed Term Contract with no liability on CEIL for regular appointment at any stage; total contract period will not exceed 36 months under any circumstances.
  • Candidates not willing to serve anywhere in India - posting can be at any CEIL office or project site across India at the discretion of management.
  • OBC candidates from creamy layer - only OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates are eligible for reservation benefits.
  • PwD candidates with less than 40% disability - minimum 40% disability is required for PwD relaxation benefits.
  • Candidates without a valid and functional email ID that can remain active for at least 24 months from date of application - all communications will be via email only.
  • Candidates for the Safety Officer post without a Degree/Diploma in Industrial Safety in addition to the engineering degree - both are mandatory.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying for CEIL Recruitment 2026?

  • Not checking ASNT Level-II certification status before applying for Mechanical/Production QA/QC posts - it is mandatory and absence will disqualify the application.
  • Miscalculating experience years - experience must be post-qualification (after engineering degree/diploma) and is counted as on 30.04.2026, not the date of application.
  • Applying with CGPA/OGPA without converting to equivalent percentage - candidates must indicate the equivalent percentage as per university/institute norms and be ready to produce documentary proof at interview.
  • Applying through any mode other than CEIL's official recruitment portal (https://www6.eil.co.in/ceilrecruitment/) - applications through any other mode will not be entertained.
  • Providing an incorrect or inactive email ID - all communications including interview/test intimation will be via email only; CEIL will not be responsible for loss of communication due to invalid email.
  • Applying for Grade-II posts in Marketing, SCM, or Office Management without adequate experience in those specific functional areas - engineering qualification alone is not sufficient; relevant functional experience is mandatory.
  • Not keeping track of CEIL's official website www.ceil.co.in - any change in last date or other schedule will be communicated only through the website, not separately.
  • Attending the interview without carrying all original documents - absence of any required document (age proof, marksheets, experience certificates, salary slip, category certificate) will result in disqualification from interview.
  • Canvassing in any form - this will immediately result in disqualification.
  • Not preparing 5 copies of the Annexure (CV format) - shortlisted candidates will need to bring 5 copies of the Annexure, which will be sent only to shortlisted candidates by CEIL.

How to Apply for CEIL Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online only through CEIL's official recruitment portal. Applications received through any other mode shall not be entertained. Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date. Applications found incomplete or received after the due date are liable to be rejected.

Documents Required at the time of Interview:

  • Proof of Age (10th / Matriculation certificate)
  • Educational and Professional Qualifications (all marksheets & certificates)
  • Service Certificate of past employment, proof of date of joining & continuity in present organization (if applicable) & latest salary slip
  • Medical Certificate for PwD (if applicable) with photograph from competent authority, confirming minimum 40% disability
  • SC / ST / OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate from competent authority (OBC certificate must clearly state non-creamy layer status)
  • EWS certificate from competent authority
  • 5 copies of duly filled Annexure / CV (format sent to shortlisted candidates only)

Apply Online at: https://www6.eil.co.in/ceilrecruitment/

For further updates: Visit www.ceil.co.in → Careers section

Important Instructions for CEIL Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • This is a Fixed Term Contract engagement - purely on a temporary basis. It does not carry any liability on CEIL for regular appointment at any stage. Total contract period will not exceed 36 months under any circumstances.
  • Initial appointment is for one year, extendable (if required) for another 36 months or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance.
  • Selected candidates will initially be posted at CEIL Head Office, Navi Mumbai but may be posted at any CEIL office or project site anywhere in India at management's discretion. Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India need apply.
  • No perks or allowances other than the consolidated salary are payable. In case of extension beyond one year, increment @ 3% per year will be considered for the next 2 years.
  • Fixed Term Personnel must take Medical Insurance of minimum ₹2,00,000/- for self; the premium will be reimbursed by CEIL.
  • CGPA/OGPA/CPI or letter grade in Degree must be converted to equivalent percentage as per university/institute norms and documentary proof will be required at interview.
  • No TA/DA will be given for attending interviews.
  • Candidates must be of sound health; Medical Fitness Certificate from Government Hospital / Company Nominated Hospital is required at the time of joining (expense reimbursable on original receipt).
  • Contractual engagement may be terminated by CEIL at any time at its sole discretion without assigning any reason if performance/conduct is found unsatisfactory.
  • For termination during currency of contract, one month's written notice or one month's consolidated pay in lieu thereof shall be given by either party.
  • Reservation and relaxation for PwDs shall be as per GOI guidelines. Persons with 40% or more disabilities are eligible.
  • Experience prescribed is relaxable at the discretion of CEIL for SC/ST candidates.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • Number of vacancies indicated are only tentative; CEIL reserves the right to cancel/restrict/modify/alter selection/recruitment process at any stage without notice.
  • CEIL also reserves the right to reject any candidature without assigning any reason whatsoever.
  • Any dispute arising from this recruitment will be under the jurisdiction of Mumbai court only.

NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process

Selection will be made purely on the basis of merit drawn from qualifying examination marks, followed by document scrutiny and a mandatory medical test. No written examination will be conducted by NCL for this recruitment.

Stage 1 – Merit List Preparation

For Graduate and Diploma positions, merit is drawn on the basis of marks scored in the qualifying Graduation/Diploma examination. For ITI Trade positions, merit is based on the average of passing percentage in Matriculation and the respective National/State Trade Certificate. Candidates are arranged in descending order of marks. In case of a tie, date of birth (older candidate preferred) and then alphabetical order of name will be applied.

Stage 2 – Document Scrutiny

Shortlisted candidates based on merit will be called to appear with all original certificates for scrutiny. Date and venue will be notified on nclcil.in and through NATS/NAPS portal or email. Failure to appear or produce valid documents within the stipulated date and time will result in cancellation of candidature.

Stage 3 – Medical Examination

Final offer for Apprenticeship Training is subject to clearing the Medical Test as per prescribed standards under the Mines Rules 1955. A fitness certificate from the medical officer of a Government Hospital (rank not less than Assistant Civil Surgeon) in the prescribed format (Annexure-3) must be produced. The Medical Fitness certificate must be issued after the date of release of this Notification.

Who should NOT apply for NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Candidates who have already undergone Apprenticeship Training earlier or are currently pursuing Apprenticeship in any industry.
  • Candidates with 1 year or more of job experience.
  • Candidates who have passed their qualifying degree/diploma/ITI before June 2022.
  • Candidates who possess qualifications higher than the prescribed qualification for the applied discipline.
  • Candidates whose qualifying institution is not functional and operational in Uttar Pradesh or Madhya Pradesh.
  • Candidates whose qualifications were obtained through Part-time, Correspondence, or Distance Learning mode.
  • OBC candidates belonging to the Creamy Layer.
  • Candidates who submit multiple applications - multiple applications will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates who are unable to produce a valid Medical Fitness certificate as per Mines Rules 1955.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Not pre-registering on the NATS portal (for Graduate/Diploma) or NAPS portal (for Trade/ITI) before applying - without a valid Enrolment ID, the application cannot be completed.
  • Applying for more than one discipline - multiple applications will lead to disqualification of candidature.
  • Entering incorrect percentage/marks scored or maximum marks in the online form - candidature will be cancelled if found incorrect during scrutiny.
  • Not checking that the qualifying institution is functional and operational in Uttar Pradesh or Madhya Pradesh.
  • Uploading blurred or unclear photograph or signature in black ink.
  • Not having an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least one year for future communication.
  • Rounding off the passing percentage - NCL will not consider rounding off (49.99% will be treated as less than 50%).
  • Not taking a printout of the finally submitted online application for future reference.

How to Apply for NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27

Candidates must apply online only. Graduate and Diploma Apprentice candidates must first enrol on the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and Trade Apprentice candidates must enrol on the NAPS portal at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. After successful registration, a registration number (Enrolment ID) will be generated, following which the candidate must apply for the NCL positions through the respective portal.

Documents/Details required at the time of Online Application:

  • Valid NATS/NAPS Enrolment ID (registration reference).
  • Scanned colour photograph and scanned signature in black ink (as per portal specifications).
  • Date of Birth as per Matriculation certificate.
  • Academic details - total marks scored and maximum marks in qualifying degree/diploma/ITI trade.
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) in prescribed format (Annexure-1), if applicable.
  • PwBD disability certificate as per Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules 2017 (Annexure-2), if applicable.
  • Address for correspondence and permanent address.

Candidates must save and preserve a hard copy as well as soft copy of the finally submitted online application for future reference. No paper-based or postal applications will be accepted.

Apply Online (Graduate/Diploma) at: https://nats.education.gov.in

  • Online applications are open from 01-06-2026 to 15-06-2026 through NATS/NAPS portals only.

  • Information pertaining to Date of Birth, Caste Category, and Qualification once entered in the online application shall be considered final - no alteration will be permitted at later stages.
  • Stipend for Graduate and Diploma Apprentices is inclusive of the Government of India share paid through DBT; Trade Apprentice stipend will be paid directly by NCL.
  • Stipend will be paid directly into the AADHAAR-linked bank account of the Apprenticeship Trainee as per the signed contract.
  • Apprenticeship Training is purely temporary and statutory in nature - it does not confer any right or claim for regular employment in NCL.
  • Apprentices are eligible for 11 days Casual Leave and 15 days Medical Leave per year of training.
  • Engagement hours are between 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
  • Apprentices will be covered under the Workmen Compensation Act, 1923 for any accident during training.
  • No accommodation, fooding/lodging, or transport will be provided during the training period.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in document scrutiny or post-scrutiny processes.
  • Canvassing in any manner at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Any dispute will be subject to courts/tribunals of Singrauli, MP only.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying Oil India Limited Recruitment 2026?

  • Claiming CGPA as percentage without converting to percentage as per university/institute norms - CGPA must be converted and the equivalent percentage clearly mentioned; rounding off is not permitted.
  • Using the same email ID or mobile number as another candidate - the same email/mobile cannot be shared between candidates; duplicate details will cause registration failure.
  • Submitting multiple applications and not ensuring the one with the highest Application Sequence Number is complete - OIL will only process the application with the highest sequence number for each post.
  • Uploading documents exceeding 5 MB per file or 200 MB total - applications with oversized attachments may face technical rejection.

What Is CSEB Kerala? - Understanding the Recruitment Process

The Cooperative Service Examination Board (CSEB), Kerala, is the state body that conducts recruitment examinations for vacancies in Kerala's cooperative banks and societies. Unlike PSC (Public Service Commission) which recruits for government departments, CSEB specifically handles the cooperative sector.

The recruitment process works in two layers:

  1. CSEB conducts the written examination and prepares a ranked list of qualified candidates for each advertisement
  2. The individual cooperative bank/society conducts the interview from the shortlisted candidates and makes the final appointment

This means that after you clear the written exam, the specific bank where the vacancy exists will call you for an interview. Final appointment is made by that bank - you are an employee of the cooperative bank, not a Kerala Government employee. However, the salary scales, service conditions, and regulations are governed by the Kerala Cooperative Societies Act and rules.

Why Apply for a Kerala Cooperative Bank Job?

Many candidates overlook cooperative bank jobs while focusing only on PSC or central government posts. Here is why CSEB recruitment deserves serious consideration:

  • Stable, permanent employment governed by the Kerala Co-operative Societies Act
  • Pay scales competitive with state government Level equivalents for the same qualifications
  • Local posting - most cooperative banks post staff within the district or region, unlike state government transfers
  • Less competition than PSC exams - the candidate pool for CSEB exams is significantly smaller than for state-level PSC recruitments
  • Multiple banks in one advertisement - you can apply to multiple institutions in the same advt by paying an additional ₹50 per bank, increasing your selection chances significantly
  • Fresher-friendly - the Junior Clerk posts especially have no experience requirement

Tips for CSEB Written Exam Preparation

  • The 100-question, 100-mark written exam typically covers: General Knowledge, Current Affairs, Kerala-specific awareness, Cooperative law and principles, Mathematics/Reasoning, and English/Malayalam language
  • For Secretary and Assistant Secretary posts, expect questions on cooperative management, accounting principles, banking regulations, and the Kerala Cooperative Societies Act in depth
  • For Junior Clerk posts, the pattern is closer to a standard clerical aptitude test - reasoning, basic arithmetic, language comprehension
  • For System Administrator, expect technical questions on networking, OS administration, database management, and IT security alongside cooperative awareness
  • For DEO, expect typing/computer knowledge components alongside the written test
  • The minimum qualifying score is low (4/20 for interview eligibility) but the real competition is in clearing the cutoff that gets you called for an interview - typically much higher in popular banks. Focus on scoring in the top tier rather than just qualifying.

Can You Apply for Multiple Banks in the Same Advertisement?

Yes - and this is a significant strategic advantage. Unlike most government recruitment processes where you apply to one organization, the CSEB system allows a single candidate to apply to multiple cooperative banks under the same advertisement number. Each additional bank beyond the first requires an extra ₹50 exam fee.

For example, under Advt. 17/2026 (Junior Clerk – Super Grade), if you want to be considered for 3 banks, you pay: ₹150 (first bank) + ₹50 + ₹50 = ₹250 (+ 18% GST).

This is particularly useful for candidates who are flexible about work location within Kerala, as it dramatically increases the number of vacancies you are effectively competing for.

Sourced from official CSEB Kerala notifications Advt. No. 15/2026 to 21/2026, issued by the Cooperative Service Examination Board, Thiruvananthapuram, dated May 30, 2026.

Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must possess the following educational qualifications as on the last date of application. Knowledge of Kannada is mandatory for all posts - candidates must be able to read, write, speak, and understand Kannada.

Sr. No. Post Name Educational Qualification
1 Manager / First Division Assistant 1. Must have passed a degree from any University established by law in India. 2. Must have the ability to read Kannada along with knowledge of Kannada language, writing, clear spoken Kannada, and ability to understand Kannada. 3. Must have knowledge of computer operation.
2 Second Division Assistant 1. Must have passed Second PUC or equivalent from a recognized institution, or currently studying. 2. Must have the ability to read Kannada along with knowledge of Kannada language, writing, clear spoken Kannada, and ability to understand Kannada. 3. Must have knowledge of computer operation.
3 Vehicle Driver 1. Must have passed SSLC; must be able to read Kannada as one language. 2. Must hold a valid legal driving license.
4 Junior Servant 1. Must have passed SSLC; must be able to read Kannada as one language.

Note:

  • If reserved category seats for Women / Rural Candidates / Ex-Servicemen remain unfilled after shortlisting, those vacancies will be filled from other eligible candidates in the respective category.
  • Rule 371(J) reservation: Posts reserved for Kalyana Karnataka Region are for candidates from that region. Non-371(J) refers to posts from the rest of the state (outside Kalyana Karnataka region).

Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

(A) Manager / First Division Assistant

Step 1 - Written Examination + Interview: Vacancy filling is done through written examination and personal interview.

Step 2 - Shortlisting for Written Exam: Online applications are screened based on prescribed educational qualifications and required documents. Eligible candidates are called for written examination conducted by an external government-authorized body. Based on marks scored in the prescribed written examination, an eligibility list is prepared and candidates are called for interview in a 1:5 ratio (15 marks minimum to qualify for interview).

Step 3 - Merit List: Written exam marks (minimum 85 out of 100 to qualify) combined with interview marks are totaled to prepare a final merit list (Merit List), following reservation norms for final appointment.

Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026 - How to Apply

Candidates must apply Online only through the Bank's official website. No other mode of application will be accepted. Before filling the application, candidates must mandatorily read the notification and instructions carefully.

Step-by-Step Application Process:

Step 1: Visit the Bank's official website https://www.bellarydcc.bank.in and open the link "BDCC RECRUITMENT 2026" on a desktop/laptop computer. Read the notification and instructions carefully before filling the application.

  • After clicking the registration box, a confirmation check box will appear for candidates who have previously applied and paid the fee. Those candidates must re-submit the application with the same registration number clearly mentioned, upload documents, and re-submit.
  • A check box will appear: "Are you re-applying after already submitting an application and fee payment?" If Yes, mention the previous application registration number clearly, upload documents, and re-submit the application.

Step 2: Visit http://www.bellarydcc.bank.in, register and log in. Enter your SSLC marks, name, date of birth, disability status, and other required details. Verify mobile number and email ID via OTP. Register successfully.

  • Candidates who previously applied and downloaded the application under the earlier notification must register again with a new registration number and re-upload documents per the new requirements. Fee once paid for the earlier application is not refunded, and no separate fee is required again for that post.

Step 3: Use your registration number and date of birth as login credentials. Review and edit all details and qualification information if needed. Preview the application carefully before confirming. Once submitted, no information can be changed.

Step 4: Upload Photo and Signature. The candidate must upload their passport-size photograph on a blank white paper with signature below using a black Sketch/Marker pen; scan and upload. Applications without photo/signature or incomplete applications will be rejected.

  • After uploading photo and signature, upload all required SSLC marks/reservation-related documents with self-attestation, then submit.

Step 5: After submitting, pay the application fee and applicable gateway charges through the Payment Gateway link.

Photo Specifications:

  • File size: Less than 100 KB
  • DPI Setting: 100 DPI
  • Quality: 100%
  • Color: Color
  • Format: JPG/JPEG
  • Photo size: 35mm × 45mm; Signature below: 35mm × 20mm

Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents

The following documents must be uploaded online at the time of application and must be valid as on the last date of application. Originals must be produced at the time of verification.

For All Posts:

  1. Educational qualification certificates or mark sheets for the prescribed qualification (all years/semesters).
  2. SSLC marks card / School attendance certificate or Cumulative Record Extract (for date of birth proof).
  3. Category/reservation certificate as applicable.

For Reservation / Age Relaxation Certificates:

  1. Ex-Servicemen: Discharge certificate and Pension/Gratuity certificate from the authorized authority.
  2. SC/ST (Category A, B, C) / ST-Pangada candidates: Category certificates in the prescribed Government format - SC/ST in Form-D/E/F as applicable; Category-1 candidates in Form-E; 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B candidates in Form-F issued by concerned Tahsildar.
  3. Candidates currently employed: Service certificate from employer and No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the relevant recruitment authority.
  4. Kalyana Karnataka Region candidates: Eligibility proof certificate as per Annexure-2 from the authorized sub-divisional authority.
  5. Rural candidates: Certificate in Form-1 and General candidates in Form-1 and Form-2 from the concerned Tahsildar.
  6. Differently-Abled candidates: Medical certificate from the District-level Medical Board in the prescribed Government format.
  7. Manager / First Division Assistant post: All year/semester mark sheets of the degree.
  8. Second Division Assistant post: Second PUC mark sheets / current student proof.
  9. Vehicle Driver post: SSLC marks card and valid legal driving license.
  10. Junior Servant post: SSLC marks card.
  11. Candidates applying for any post must mandatorily upload a self-portrait passport-size photograph with signature as described above.
  12. Candidates currently working anywhere must upload service certificate from the head of that organization and a No Objection Certificate.
  13. Rural / Ex-Servicemen / Kannada Medium / Differently-Abled category claimants must upload the competent authority-issued certificate.

Special Instructions for Previously Applied Candidates

  • Candidates who had applied and paid the fee under Bank Recruitment Notification No. 12:2026–27 dated 06.04.2026 and who wish to apply for the same posts in the current notification must mandatorily re-apply online. They must clearly mention the previous registration number and re-upload all required documents. No separate fee payment is required for those posts.

  • Candidates who had applied and downloaded the application under the 06.04.2026 notification must register freshly with a new registration number, re-submit, and upload documents as per current requirements. Once Application Re-submit is done, it cannot be re-edited and fees paid will not be refunded. Each post still requires a separate application; one Application Re-submit per post is allowed.
  • Information regarding re-application will be communicated via SMS and email to the registered mobile number and email ID of candidates who had previously applied and downloaded their application under the earlier notification.

Caste Reservation Certificate Requirements

For candidates claiming reservation benefits:

  • SC (Category A, B, C) / ST / Pangada candidates: Upload certificate in Form-D
  • Category-1 candidates: Upload certificate in Form-E
  • Category-2A, 2B, 3A, 3B candidates: Upload certificate in Form-F, obtained from the concerned Tahsildar; these certificates for Backward Hindu categories must be valid within 5 years from the date of application.

Rural Candidate Reservation:

  • Rural candidates must have studied from Class 1 to Class 10 in a village (rural area) under the current rules; certificate must be current and valid.
  • SC/ST/Pangada candidates claiming Rural reservation must submit Form-2 rural reservation certificate.
  • General category candidates claiming rural reservation must submit Form-1 rural certificate along with proof that they are not otherwise listed as urban.
  • General category, SC/ST/Pangada, Category-1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B candidates who fail to submit the required rural reservation certificate will be treated as ineligible for rural reservation.
  • Note: Certificate in Form-2 must be obtained from the Headmaster of the school where the candidate studied and attested by the concerned field education officer.

Kannada Medium Candidates:

  • Candidates claiming Kannada Medium reservation must submit a certificate from the Headmaster of the school where they studied Kannada medium along with date of school's issue, signed certificate, and must be held valid as on the last date of application. Original copies must be produced at verification. If not produced, the Kannada Medium reservation will be cancelled.

Scheme-Deprived (Yojane Nirashritha) Candidates:

  • Must produce a certificate from the concerned Tahsildar in the prescribed format as per current rules. Certificate must be valid up to the last date of application and must be current.

Ex-Servicemen:

  • Ex-Serviceman means a person who has served in any rank (combatant or non-combatant) in the Central Armed Forces (Army, Navy, Air Force) - excluding persons who served in Defence Security Corps, General Reserve Engineering Force, Lok Sahayak Sena, and Para-Military Forces.
  • Family members (spouse/husband/wife and children, including adopted children) of persons who died while serving in Central Armed Forces are eligible for Ex-Servicemen reservation; however, age relaxation will not be provided to them.
  • Eligible cases for Ex-Servicemen reservation:
    • Retired voluntarily from such service after receiving pension; OR
    • Released from military service on medical grounds with medical and physical disability pension; OR
    • Released from service due to reduction of personnel; OR
    • Released from service after completing specific service and receiving gratuity, after fulfilling period of service - including: persons retired from continuous service, persons with physical disability due to military service, and gazette prize winners.
  • Persons currently re-employed in government service after retiring from military service must apply for military reservation through their current service NOC before appointment; they are allowed to enjoy all benefits available to ex-servicemen during re-employment, but the bank will not be responsible if they are not matched with the post. They must submit their discharge certificate before applying.
  • Ex-servicemen applicants, persons dependent on ex-servicemen who were killed or permanently disabled while in service - (spouse/husband/wife and children, including adopted children) - are eligible for Ex-Servicemen reservation benefits. Age relaxation will not be provided to dependents. They must submit the discharge certificate and permanence/gratuity certificate; at the time of original document verification, original copies must be produced.

Differently-Abled (Physically Challenged) Candidates:

  • Only candidates with a minimum of 40% benchmark disability certified by the District-level Medical Board in the prescribed Government format (NOT in any other format) are eligible for differently-abled reservation. Certificate must be issued in the prescribed Government notification format.
  • Differently-Abled candidates who require a scribe for the written examination must upload a special medical certificate from the Medical Board stating that they are unable to write due to physical disability.
  • The scribe requirement must be indicated at the time of application in the specified field in the online application; only when required, the candidate may request a scribe from the examination centre authority.

Who Should NOT Apply for Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not meet the prescribed educational qualifications (degree for Manager/FDA; Second PUC for SDA; SSLC for Driver and Junior Servant) as on the last date of application.

  • Candidates who cannot read, write, speak, and understand Kannada - knowledge of Kannada is mandatory for all posts.
  • Candidates below 18 years of age or above the maximum age limit applicable to their category.
  • OBC (Category-2A/2B/3A/3B) Creamy Layer candidates applying under reserved categories - only non-Creamy Layer OBC candidates are eligible for reservation.
  • Candidates with less than 40% disability who apply for Differently-Abled reservation - only 40%+ benchmark disability qualifies.
  • Vehicle Driver candidates who do not hold a valid legal driving license.
  • Candidates currently employed in any organization who cannot produce an NOC from their employer.
  • Candidates who obtained degrees or certificates from institutions declared fake or derecognized by competent educational authorities - such applications will be rejected at any stage.
  • Candidates who provide false information or suppress facts - such candidates are liable for criminal prosecution and disqualification at any stage of the selection process.
  • Persons who are members of or active in any banned organization, or who have attempted to overthrow the Government of India, or who have been convicted under any law, or who have taken part in activities against the sovereignty or integrity of India, or who have been dismissed from any government service.
  • Candidates with mental illness or mental disability.
  • A male candidate who has more than one living wife, and a woman candidate who has married a man who already has another living wife, are not eligible.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying for the wrong post for which you do not meet the educational qualification.

  • Selecting the wrong category (General/SC/ST/OBC/EWS) - categories cannot be changed after submission; mismatched certificates lead to cancellation.
  • OBC (Backward Hindu 2A/2B/3A/3B) candidates from Creamy Layer applying under OBC reservation instead of General category.
  • Not uploading all mandatory documents at the time of online application - incomplete applications will be rejected outright.
  • Uploading blurred, illegible, or incorrect photographs, signatures, or certificates - leading to rejection at document verification stage.
  • Using an inactive or wrong mobile number and email ID - exam dates, interview schedules, and admit cards are communicated only through SMS and email.
  • Submitting multiple applications for the same post without following the proper Re-submit process - only the last valid application is considered and fees for others are forfeited.
  • Not reading the separate instructions for candidates who applied under the earlier notification (06.04.2026) - they must re-apply with their old registration number and need not pay fee again for the same post.
  • Not noting that each post requires a separate application and separate fee - applying for multiple posts with a single application/fee is not permitted.
  • Paying the fee through DD/Postal Order/Money Order or any offline mode - only online payment (Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI/Google Pay) is accepted.
  • Not keeping originals of all uploaded documents ready for verification - originals must be produced at the time of interview/verification.
  • Ignoring the minimum qualifying mark requirement: candidates must score a minimum of 85 out of 100 (or 200) in the written examination to qualify for the interview.

Essential Experience Minimum 1 year of experience in a Scheduled Commercial Bank or All India Financial Institution or any other organization of repute, in Information Security functions.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be based on Written Test followed by Personal Interview. Candidates shortlisted based on written test performance will be called for Personal Interview. Final selection will be based on overall performance in both stages. Written Examination carries 70% weightage and Personal Interview carries 30% weightage in the final merit list. There will be no sectional cut-off in the written test. Exim Bank will analyse responses to detect patterns of similarity - if copying is inferred, candidature will be cancelled.

Examination centres: Kolkata, Mumbai, New Delhi, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad (may change if sufficient candidates not available). Personal Interviews will be conducted only in Mumbai and New Delhi. Written test carries 70% weightage; Interview carries 30% weightage in final merit.

Stage 2 - Personal Interview

Candidates shortlisted on the basis of written test performance will be called for Personal Interview at Mumbai or New Delhi. Candidates must produce original degree certificates, caste, experience and other relevant certificates at the time of interview. Candidates already in service must carry a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate from their present employer at the time of joining.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager (Information Security) Recruitment 2026 - Pre-Recruitment Training

A pre-recruitment training will be organized for candidates from reserved categories. Details of the training and its mode of delivery (online/offline) will be intimated to candidates who opt for it through the online application form. Details will be shared after the last date of registration.

Who should NOT apply for Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not hold a full-time B.E./B.Tech./M.Tech./M.E./M.C.A. in Computer Science/IT/Electronics & Communication - degrees from other disciplines or part-time/distance/correspondence courses are strictly ineligible.
  • Candidates with aggregate marks below 60% in their qualifying degree - the 60% minimum is a hard eligibility condition.
  • Candidates who do not have at least 1 year of post-qualification experience in Information Security functions in a Scheduled Commercial Bank, All India Financial Institution, or other organization of repute - experience in unrelated IT roles does not qualify.
  • Candidates outside the age band of 21 to 28 years as on 01-05-2026 (except those entitled to OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen relaxation).
  • OBC Creamy Layer candidates expecting OBC reservation or age relaxation - they must apply as General.
  • Candidates not willing to serve anywhere in India - posting is at the Bank's requirement at any location in India including transfers to overseas offices with consent.
  • Candidates who cannot commit to the 5-year service bond of Rs. 3 lakh - this bond is mandatory and must be executed at the time of joining.
  • Candidates currently in government service who cannot produce a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate from their employer at the time of joining - they will not be allowed to join without it.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying Exim Bank Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?

  • Uploading a signature in CAPITAL LETTERS - capital letter signatures are not accepted and will lead to rejection.
  • Not writing the handwritten declaration personally in English - if written by anyone else or in any other language, the application will be declared invalid.
  • Not uploading a live photograph via webcam/mobile at the time of filling the application - this is mandatory in addition to the static scanned photograph.
  • Uploading blurry, smudged, or unclear photograph, signature, left thumb impression, or handwritten declaration - such applications may be rejected; candidates should preview all uploads before final submission.
  • Not cross-checking that the name in the application exactly matches the name on the photo identity proof - any mismatch leads to denial of entry at the examination/interview; female candidates who have changed name post-marriage must be especially careful.
  • Clicking Back or Refresh during online fee payment - this may cause double charges; wait for server intimation after payment submission.
  • Not taking a printout of the e-Receipt and online application form after fee payment - this is required for future reference.
  • Not keeping the email ID and mobile number active till the end of the recruitment process - all communications including admit card, call letters, and results are sent only via email/SMS.
  • Not furnishing the CGPA conversion formula/letter from University/Institute if degree is CGPA-based - without this, the equivalent percentage cannot be verified and candidature may be rejected.
  • Waiting till the last date to apply - the Bank is not responsible for website outages or connectivity issues; candidates must apply well before 14-06-2026.

Competition Level Analysis for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026

The competition level for Exim Bank MT Recruitment 2026 is expected to be very intense given that only 05 vacancies are on offer across two disciplines from a large pool of MBA/PGDBM graduates across India. The Bank being a premier financial institution under the Government of India makes this an exceptionally sought-after position among finance, HR, and administration postgraduates. The subjective Written Test format — unlike the MCQ-based bank exams — demands strong subject knowledge, analytical writing ability, and command over HR / Administration concepts rather than just speed and aptitude.

The low vacancy count means even marginal differences in written test scores will determine shortlisting for the interview round. Candidates with domain depth in HRM/Personnel Management (for MT-HRM) or Hotel/Facilities/Civil background with MBA (for MT-Administration) are better positioned. The Personal Interview carrying 30% of the final weightage means soft skills, subject clarity, and awareness of Exim Bank's functions and India's international trade ecosystem will be critical differentiators at the final stage.

  • Candidates whose CGPA-based qualification does not include an equivalent percentage conversion letter from the Head of Institute/Controller of Examination (if percentage is not mentioned in marksheet).

Common mistakes / What to check before applying Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

What is Railway Recruitment Board City Intimation Slip 2026?

The Railway Recruitment Board City Intimation Slip 2026 is an advance notification document released before the admit card. It provides candidates with essential preliminary information about their examination to help them make necessary travel and accommodation arrangements. The city slip is NOT your admit card but serves as an important reference document.

Key Information Available in City Slip:

  • Allotted exam city and state
  • Scheduled exam date
  • Shift timing (Morning/Afternoon/Evening)
  • Reporting time at exam center
  • Gate closing time
  • Candidate's name and registration number
  • Category (SC/ST/OBC/General/EWS)
  • PwBD status (if applicable)

Important Notice: The city intimation slip is NOT your admit card and does not permit you to appear in the exam. It is only for informational purposes. You must download the admit card separately (available 4 days before exam) to enter the examination hall.

How to Download Railway Recruitment Board City Intimation Slip 2026? (Step-by-Step Guide)

Step 1: Visit Official Website

  • Open your web browser (Chrome, Firefox, or Edge recommended)
  • Visit Railway Recruitment Board official website: https://www.rrbcdg.gov.in
  • Or use your regional RRB website if applicable
  • Ensure you have stable internet connection
  • On the homepage, scroll down to "Latest Updates" or "Important Links" section
  • Look for link: "Railway Recruitment Board City Intimation Slip 2026" or "Download City Slip for NTPC CEN 07/2025"
  • Click on the city intimation slip download link
  • You may be redirected to a candidate login page
  • Enter your Registration Number or Application Number
  • Enter your Date of Birth in DD/MM/YYYY format OR Password
  • Type the Captcha Code as shown in the image (case-sensitive)
  • Double-check all entered information for accuracy
  • Click on the "Submit" or "Login" button
  • Your city intimation slip will appear on the screen
  • Carefully verify all details displayed
  • Check: Name, Registration No., Exam City, Date, Shift Timing
  • Click on "Download" or "Save as PDF" button
  • Save the file to your computer/mobile device
  • Take a printout of the city slip for reference
  • Save a backup copy in cloud storage (Google Drive/Email)
  • Keep both digital and physical copies safe

Download your city intimation slip as soon as it is released to avoid server overload and last-minute technical issues. The website may experience heavy traffic during peak hours.

Common Issues & Solutions While Downloading City Slip

Issue 1: Unable to Login / Invalid Credentials Error

Solutions:

  • Verify your registration number carefully (no spaces before/after)
  • Check date of birth format: DD/MM/YYYY (e.g., 15/08/1998)
  • Ensure CAPS LOCK is off while entering details
  • Clear your browser cache and cookies (Ctrl+Shift+Del)
  • Try using a different web browser (Chrome, Firefox, or Edge)
  • Use "Forgot Registration Number" link if you don't remember it
  • Check your registered email for registration confirmation

Issue 2: City Slip Not Showing / Page Not Loading

Solutions:

  • Verify if city slip is released for your specific exam date
  • Try downloading during non-peak hours (early morning 6-8 AM or late night 11 PM onwards)
  • Disable VPN, proxy, or ad-blocker extensions
  • Check your internet connection stability
  • Try using mobile data instead of WiFi (or vice versa)
  • Use incognito/private browsing mode
  • Update your web browser to the latest version
  • Try accessing from mobile app if available

Issue 3: Error in Details Displayed on City Slip

Solutions:

  • Contact Railway Recruitment Board helpdesk immediately
  • Email to: [email protected] with screenshot
  • Call helpline: 080-4719-2000 (working hours: 10 AM - 5 PM)
  • Keep your registration number and application details ready
  • Explain the exact discrepancy in detail
  • Request for correction before exam date

Issue 4: PDF Download Not Working

Solutions:

  • Take a screenshot of the city slip as backup
  • Try "Print to PDF" option (Ctrl+P then save as PDF)
  • Use a different PDF reader (Adobe Acrobat Reader)
  • Check if pop-ups are blocked in browser settings
  • Ensure sufficient storage space on device
  • Try downloading from different device

Issue 5: Captcha Not Visible or Loading

Solutions:

  • Refresh the page (F5 key)
  • Enable JavaScript in browser settings
  • Disable browser extensions temporarily

Track each client’s application pipeline from saved to applied to interviewing and keep records updated. 10. Communicate proactively with clients when attention or input is required. 11. Flag patterns, blockers, or client issues to internal leads before they become problems. Comfortable working with LinkedIn, spreadsheets, email clients, and new SaaS tools. 5. High ownership mindset with the ability to manage deliverables independently. 6. Ability to handle multiple clients and priorities simultaneously without missing deadlines. 7. Good understanding of corporate hierarchy and stakeholder targeting. 8. Previous startup experience is a strong plus. 9. Familiarity with ATS systems, cold email tools, or LinkedIn outreach is a strong plus. What good looks like at 90 days: 1. Managing a full client portfolio independently with minimal escalations. 2. Ensuring client reports and outreach activities are delivered consistently on time. 3. Proactively flagging edge cases and judgment calls instead of making assumptions or remaining silent. 4. Helping clients receive replies and schedule interviews successfully.

Founded in 2017, Toyota Ventures is a San Francisco Bay Area-based venture capital firm with $800M+ AUM that invests in early-stage startups around the world in deep tech and climate solutions. Our firm is growing and we are looking for an associate for the Toyota Ventures Frontier Fund(s) to help source and screen innovative companies in areas like AI, advanced materials, automation and robotics, and space tech. Along with a degree in a relevant field and a minimum of 4 years of related work experience, we are seeking someone with a strong understanding of deep tech. Hands-on experience in a development or product management role related to one of our investment areas is a plus. The role also requires excellent written and verbal communication skills, an understanding of industry trends, and a knack for spotting the early stage startups that are defining those trends. 


 


The ideal candidate will be a natural networker who is already plugged into the startup ecosystem and is familiar with leading entrepreneurs and investors in deep tech. We also value diversity, acting with integrity, being humble but bold, and âkeeping it weird.â  If this sounds like a good fit, and you’re passionate about finding and funding innovative companies, we look forward to hearing from you!

  • Network and take part in industry and VC events, organizations

  • Help generate deal-flow and source high-potential target companies 

  • Meet with and evaluate companies to make recommendations on investing

  • Participate in due diligence, competitive analyses, and industry deep dives

  • Support deal negotiations and closings

  • Analyze latest industry trends and author market research briefings

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and risk

  • Ability to work collaboratively with team members

  • Track record of successfully completing projects with minimal guidance

Job Description: Graphic Narrator

Job Title: Graphic Narrator

Department: Creative Services / Content Development

Reports To: Project Manager

Position Summary

Resilient Solutions Plus is seeking a project specific creative and visually driven Graphic Narrator to transform ideas, stories, concepts, and information into compelling visual narratives. The Graphic Narrator combines graphic design, storytelling, and communication skills to create engaging visual content that informs, educates, entertains, or persuades audiences across digital and print platforms.

The ideal candidate can communicate complex messages through illustrations, infographics, sequential art, motion graphics, presentations, and other visual storytelling formats while maintaining brand consistency and audience engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop visual narratives that communicate stories, data, concepts, or brand messages.
  • Create storyboards, infographics, illustrated content, comics, visual reports, and presentation materials.
  • Collaborate with writers, marketers, educators, content creators, and subject matter experts to develop visual storytelling solutions.
  • Translate written content into engaging visual formats that improve audience understanding and retention.
  • Design layouts, characters, icons, and visual elements that support narrative flow.
  • Produce graphics for websites, social media, publications, training materials, and marketing campaigns.
  • Ensure visual content aligns with brand guidelines and communication objectives.
  • Research audience needs and adapt visual storytelling techniques accordingly.
  • Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise designs as needed.
  • Stay updated on emerging trends in graphic design, visual communication, and digital storytelling.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Illustration, Multimedia Design, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 2-5 years of experience in graphic design, illustration, visual storytelling, or content creation.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating storytelling through visual design.
  • Proficiency in design software such as Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, After Effects) or equivalent tools.
  • Excellent understanding of composition, color theory, typography, and information design.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with motion graphics, animation, or video storytelling.
  • Knowledge of UX/UI principles and interactive storytelling.
  • Experience creating educational, journalistic, or marketing-related visual content.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools and digital publishing platforms.

Key Skills

  • Visual Storytelling
  • Graphic Design
  • Illustration
  • Infographic Development
  • Storyboarding
  • Creative Thinking
  • Content Interpretation
  • Brand Communication
  • Typography & Layout Design
  • Motion Graphics (preferred)
  • Audience Engagement

Performance Indicators

  • Effectiveness of visual communication and storytelling.
  • Audience engagement and content reach.
  • Design quality and brand consistency.
  • Project completion within deadlines.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and feedback.

Sample Deliverables

  • Infographics and data visualizations
  • Illustrated articles and reports
  • Social media storytelling campaigns
  • Educational visual guides
  • Storyboards and presentation decks
  • Motion graphics and animated explainers
  • Visual narratives for websites and digital publications
